Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَتَرَاكَ بَعْدَ الْإِيـمَانِ بِكَ تُعَذِّبُنِي
Translation: My God, would You punish me after my faith in You?
Or after my love for You, would You distance me?

Arabic text: أَمْ مَعَ رَجَائِيْ لِرَحْمَتِكَ وَصَفْحِكَ تَحْرِمُنِي
Translation: Or despite my hope in Your mercy and forgiveness, would You deprive me?
Or despite my seeking refuge in Your pardon, would You forsake me?
Far be it from Your Generous Face to disappoint me!
If only I knew, did my mother bear me for misery?
Or did she raise me for hardship?
If only she had neither given birth to me nor raised me!
And if only I knew
Have You made me among the people of happiness?
And have You favored me with Your nearness and proximity?
So that my eyes would be comforted by that
And my soul would be at peace with it

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ هَلْ تُسَوِّدُ وُجُوهًا خَرَّتْ سَاجِدَةً لِعَظَمَتِكَ
Translation: My God, would You blacken faces that have prostrated to Your Greatness?

Arabic text: أَوْ تُخْرِسُ أَلْسِنَةً نَطَقَتْ بِالثَّنَاءِ عَلَى مَجْدِكَ وَجَلاَلَتِكَ
Translation: Or silence tongues that have spoken in praise of Your Glory and Majesty?

Arabic text: أَوْ تَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ انْطَوَتْ عَلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ
Translation: Or seal hearts that have embraced Your love?

Arabic text: أَوْ تُصِمُّ أَسْمَاعًا تَلَذَّذَتْ بِسَمَاعِ ذِكْرِكَ فِيْ إِرَادَتِكَ
Translation: Or deafen ears that have delighted in hearing Your remembrance in accordance with Your will?

Arabic text: أَوْ تَغُلُّ أَكُفًّا رَفَعَتْهَا الْآمَالُ إِلَيْكَ رَجَاءَ رَأْفَتِكَ
Translation: Or shackle hands that have been raised in hope toward You, seeking Your compassion?

Arabic text: أَوْ تُعَاقِبُ أَبْدَانًا عَمِلَتْ بِطَاعَتِكَ حَتَّىٰ نَحِلَتْ فِيْ مُجَاهَدَتِكَ
Translation: Or punish bodies that have worked in Your obedience until they became thin in their striving for You?

Arabic text: أَوْ تُعَذِّبُ أَرْجُلًا سَعَتْ فِيْ عِبَادَتِكَ
Translation: Or torture feet that have walked in Your worship?

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ لَا تُغْلِقْ عَلَى مُوَحِّدِيْكَ أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: My God, do not close the doors of Your mercy to those who proclaim Your Oneness

Arabic text: وَلَا تَحْجُبْ مُشْتَاقِيكَ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى جَمِيلِ رُؤْيَتِكَ
Translation: And do not veil those who long for You from gazing at Your beautiful vision
My God, a soul that You have honored with Your Oneness
How could You humiliate it with the disgrace of Your abandonment?
And a conscience bound to Your love
How could You burn it with the heat of Your fires?
My God, protect me from the pain of Your wrath
And the magnitude of Your anger
O Most Compassionate, O Benefactor
O Merciful, O Beneficent
O Compeller, O Subduer
O Forgiver, O Concealer
Save me by Your mercy from the punishment of the Fire
And from the disgrace of shame
When the good are separated from the evil
And conditions change
And terrors frighten
And the righteous are brought near
And the evil-doers are distanced
And every soul shall be paid in full for what it has earned
And they shall not be wronged
